newsitem.title: USA: Cabletron buys Netlink for 2.26 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Cabletron buys Netlink for 2.26 mln shares.

text.p: Cabletron Systems said Friday it had entered into a merger agreement to buy Netlink, a privately-held company based in Framingham, Mass., in exchange for 2,258,975 Cabletron shares.
The transaction must be approved by Netlink shareholders.
It will be accounted for as a pooling of interests and is expected to be completed by year-end, the two companies said.
Cabletron said it would operate Netlink as a stand-alone business unit.
It said the merger positions it in the frame relay market, which it said is one of the fastest-growing remote-access services for linking multi-protocol LANs over a Wide Area Network.
Cabletron said the worldwide frame relay market is expected to grow from $3.3 billion this year to $11.2 billion in 1999.
